title: Establish GNAP bridge between Zeitnus and HSCSG_v15_OS
description: Create shared .gnap directory structure in both repos to enable cross-repo agent coordination via git. Both repos have SSH/PAT access configured.
acceptance_criteria: .gnap/ directory exists in both Zeitnus_local and HSCSG_v15_OS_local
agents.json includes agents from both ecosystems
Shared task namespace for cross-repo work
Heartbeat loop documented for both agent teams
